notes.title: Version 1.1: 🔥 Hot Keys! 🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hey ChipWits fans![/p][p]We're excited to announce the release of [b]ChipWits Version 1.1[/b], an update focused on improving your programming experience and squashing some annoying bugs. The big star of this release is the new [b]Hot Keys[/b] feature.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879599/d19c35b7a616953e04df22ad3b90c23491e6331d.png"][/img][i]Hot Keys in Action![/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hot Keys are Here![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You can now assign your favorite chips to keyboard keys 1 through 8. This lets you instantly place a fully-specified chip with a single keystroke, speeding up your IBOL editing like never before. The cursor will even automatically advance to the next empty slot, keeping you in the flow.[/p][p]To help you get the hang of it, we've pre-assigned some hot keys for you in the first few tutorial missions. Once you're ready, they're all yours to customize, and your settings will be saved for future missions.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Input & Accessibility Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We've made significant improvements to how you interact with the game. We've added better support for gamepads and some early support for touchscreens. While we're still working on making the touchscreen experience perfect, you should notice an improvement.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Squashing Bugs & Polishing Up[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Finally, we've been busy fixing a number of bugs reported by the community. We've filled in some localization gaps from our initial launch, fixed audio issues where Professor Chip's beeps were too loud, and resolved a pesky bug with our radial menu.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Full Release Notes[/b][/p][p][/p][code]New Features
* #963: Alt + Click to prevent radial menu from popping up on blank slot
* #1018: Set initial volume to 50%
* #1024: Gamepad: Enable dpad for selecting chips in the workshop
* #1025: Gamepad: Left controller to select chip from radial menu
* #1027: Customizable Hot Keys 1-8
* Introduce hot keys in tutorial
* Auto advance cursor when using hot key

Bug Fixes
* #897: \[RADIAL MENU]: Selecting 'Skate' you cannot highlight a direction unless you move the mouse first
* #1012: \[AUDIO]: Volume: Professor Chip's beeps do not adhere to audio level set by user
* #1013: \[AUDIO]: Cut scene audio is incredibly loud when user has audio settings set to low
* #1014: Repeat mission says palindrome but it's not
* #1026: Localize "FIRST CHIP HERE" text
* #1028: Bug: Mission localizations for validation error toasts[/code][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy these updates! As always, please let us know what you think and report any new bugs you find. Happy coding![/p]

notes.title: ChipWits 1.0 is HERE!
notes.content: [p]Get ready to dive into a unique puzzle experience that exercises your logic and creativity circuits![/p][p]Forty years after the original and after six years in development, we're proud to announce that the new [b]ChipWits is officially RELEASED and available NOW on Steam[/b]![/p][p]What awaits you in ChipWits?[/p][list][*][p][b]A Legacy Reboot[/b]: Bringing the original 1984 game to a new generation of gamers, an accessible introduction to programming.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Easy to Learn[/b]: No prior experience required. Learn how to control your ChipWit in the step-by-step tutorial that will have you programming in no time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hard to Master[/b]: Missions build upon themselves with new challenges, chips, and mechanics. Later levels can have players using over a hundred chips across multiple chip boards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Efficiency is Key[/b]: Optimize your solutions to maximize your score, minimize the number of chips used, and minimize the number of steps in your program to secure a top spot on the global leaderboards![/p][/*][*][p][b]ChipWit Challenges[/b]: An expanding collection of standalone puzzles that challenge the ChipWit community to compete for the highest score or most efficient solution. We can't wait for you to explore the world of ChipWits and discover the joy of programming![/p]

notes.title: ChipWits: Professor Chip's Factory Demo Is Part of Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.content:
Solve your way through 11 different puzzles and see if you have what it takes to work in Professor Chip's factory! When you're done, take on a bonus mission, two ChipWit Challenges, and two classic missions from the original 1984 ChipWits!

The main story missions are set in Professor Chip’s Factory, where you will automate your ChipWit across the factory floor, maneuvering around obstacles to complete tasks.

ChipWit Challenges are an expanding catalog of standalone puzzles that will be updated regularly. Demo players can always come back and access the two most recent challenges for free as they are published.

Don't forget to Wishlist ChipWits to be notified of our upcoming release in July!

notes.title: ChipWits Demo v0.65.4: Feature Update
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
This new feature release includes some bug fixes and several significant improvements, most notably:
* Ultra-wide monitor support and support for all aspect ratios
* Improved keyboard support, including more shortcut keys and "Quick Buffers"
* Top 10 scores are now available in the histogram view (as well as the ability to not share yours)
* The ability to drag the camera around with the middle mouse or Command+Left button

Press the Field Manual button during the game to see all available hotkeys

[h1]New Features[/h1]
* #883: [SCORE]: Make it more clear when the player matches top score in the category
* #890: [USABILITY]: Hotkey page
* #891: Alt + arrows changes true connector direction
* #892: [HOTKEY]: PgUp, PgDn switches between SubPanels
* #906: Support for ultra-wide monitors, and improve support for all aspect ratios in game and puzzle selection screens
* #920: Drag the camera around with middle mouse or Command+Left button
* #924: Show top 10 scores in histogram view
* #929: Ask user if they want to be notified when new puzzles come out
* #931: [MANUAL]: Make it explicit when the game will open the browser to chipwits.com/docs
* #934: Show "Top", "All Equal", "Top x%", or "Bottom x%" as appropriate (and don't show "Top 0%")
* #935: Add noSpawn marker option to mission file format to prevent items from spawning on some tiles
* #937: Ctrl+Left Click should have the same behavior as right-click for computers with no right mouse button
* Improve keyboard behavior:
    * Add shortcut keys to all action menus
    * Restore selection after modal dialog
    * Ensure a default button selected when modal dialog opens
    * Select chip grid when mission starts, by default
* Quick Buffers: Alt 1-8 copies selected chips into a persistent buffer, 1-8 pastes
* Enable not submitting scores, not showing name in options. Show steam names in top 10
* Update Copyright to 2025

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
* #832: [DEMO]: Audio: User reported: The clicks in Video Settings" are extremely loud compared to everywhere else
* #881: BUG: Fall does not animate when speed > 16X
* #905: [DEMO]: [CRASH]: [40th Anniversary Puzzle]: Hitting escape twice while level is underway puts the game into a strange level state which eventually causes game to crash
* #906: [RESOLUTION]: On 3440x1440 resolution screen/text is cut off
* #936: [LOC]: Percentages for scoreboard show up as tofu box for some locales
* Fix animation of objective met dialog

notes.title: November Challenge: Happy 40th!
notes.content:
In celebration of ChipWits' 40th Anniversary, we're excited to launch the November challenge: Happy 40th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879599/02c92066dfeecb003ba3f74319f4e454b3c1482a.png[/img]

Believe it or not, this month is ChipWits' 40th Anniversary! In celebration, we've baked it a pie with 40 candles. Your mission is to eat all 40 candles with as few cycles as possible.

But don't run out of fuel...

Oh, and also, you start facing a random direction, so your solution will have to work for all 8 directions.

We've added a Mac-inspired 1-bit color scheme for this month's challenge, too.

To play:
[olist]
[*] Load the ChipWits Demo
[*] Select the "Happy 40th!" Challenge
[*] See if you can top the leaderboard with the [b]fewest Cycles Used[/b]
[*] Discuss your solution on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/D4G3np9RWm]ChipWits Discord Server[/url]
[/olist]

This challenge ends on the last day of November. Good luck, and stop by our Discord Server to discuss!

notes.title: ChipWits Free Demo Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Get ready to guide your ChipWit robot through a series of challenging and fun puzzles!

We’re thrilled to announce that ChipWits Free Demo is [b]officially out on Steam[/b]!

ChipWits is a programming-themed simulation puzzle game with no prior coding experience required. You use an icon-based language to guide your little robot to solve open-ended puzzles and rescue the crew of a space station taken over by a rogue AI, Dr. Droog. The original game was released in 1984 on the Mac, Commodore 64 and Apple II. This reboot maintains the spirit of the original game and is refreshed for modern audiences. It is available on Steam for PC, Mac and Linux.

The demo includes:
[list]
[*] 6 Missions from the Dr. Droog Campaign (the main storyline and tutorial)
[*] 5 Challenging Puzzles (3 easy, 1 medium, 1 hard)
[*] 2 Classic Missions from the 1984 version of ChipWits (Greedville and ChipWit Caves)
[/list]
We will also be participating in Steam NextFest on October 14, 2024.

ChipWits is even more fun when playing with friends. Please spread the word to any friends you think might be interested in our game! Thank you!
